mapper.select: SELECT d.declaration_id AS declarationId, e.execution_no AS executionNo, w.code AS workorderCode, m.code AS productCode, m.name AS productName, w.status AS workorderStatus, e.status AS executionStatus, w.source AS source, (SELECT s.material_lot_code FROM mes_production_scan_identity s WHERE s.execution_id=e.id) AS batchNo, m.specification AS specification FROM mes_production_defect d LEFT JOIN mes_production_execution e ON e.id=d.execution_id LEFT JOIN workorder w ON w.id=e.workorder_id LEFT JOIN material m ON m.id=e.product_id WHERE d.id IN #{id}

SELECT d.declaration_id AS declarationId,
MAX(CASE WHEN t.action_type='ASSESS' THEN t.attribution_type END) AS attribution, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.action_type='RETURN_NODE' THEN t.rework_qty ELSE 0 END),0) AS returnedQty, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.action_type='TRANSFER_WAREHOUSE' THEN t.transfer_qty ELSE 0 END),0) AS transferredQty, SUM(CASE WHEN t.action_type IS NOT NULL AND t.action_type NOT IN ('ASSESS','RETURN_NODE','TRANSFER_WAREHOUSE') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS invalidActions FROM mes_production_defect d LEFT JOIN mes_quality_treatment t ON t.declaration_id=d.declaration_id AND t.declaration_revision=d.revision_no WHERE d.id IN #{id} GROUP BY d.id,d.declaration_id,d.revision_no
